# Week 8 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-10-28

## Source and freshness

**Fresh committed fixture, live practice-report overlay changes one P(play).** `weekly-report-week-8.json` was generated 2026-10-27T15:36:33Z (Tuesday) — after Monday's sandbox-degraded bridge briefing, with real FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injury data, and well before Week 8's first kickoff (Thursday 10/29, CAR@GB). `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` independently confirms Week 8. Pulled live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for this Wednesday practice-report run: only 16 rows filed league-wide, covering just CAR and GB — Thursday's game, as expected five days out. Of this roster's teams, only **CAR** (Jalen Coker's team) has filed. Fit the repo's `AvailabilityModel` fresh on 2020-2025 training data (47,719 labelled player-weeks) rather than trust the raw practice splits directly, per instructions; it reproduces the fixture's own P(play) for Drake London exactly (90.4%) as a sanity check, and moves Jalen Coker's P(play) from 85.1% (fixture, no practice data) to 91.7% once Carolina's Full Participation report is folded in.

## Practice report

**One team has filed: Carolina.** Jalen Coker, this roster's bench WR, came back clean.

| Player | Designation | Wednesday practice | Model P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jalen Coker (WR, CAR, bench) | Questionable (shoulder) | **Full Participation** (live, confirmed) | 91.7% (was 85.1% pre-practice-report) |
| Drake London (WR, ATL, starting WR2) | Questionable (head) | Not yet filed — ATL has not reported | 90.4% (fixture number; model reproduces it exactly from prior history alone) |

Everyone else on this roster is tagged Healthy in the fixture, and none of their teams (LAR, IND, TB, SEA, DET, CIN, NYJ, DEN) has filed a practice report yet. Re-check Thursday night and again Friday — Friday's final designations are what actually settle London's status before Sunday.

## Start these ten — 132.82 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs LAC (Sun 4:05pm ET) | **17.10** | 97.2% | 17.60 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs JAX (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **16.61** | 95.4% | 17.40 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs ATL (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.33** | 95.4% | 16.06 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @CHI (Mon 8:15pm ET) | **23.30** | 96.9% | 24.03 |
| WR | Drake London | @TB (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.20** | 90.4% | 16.82 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | vs MIN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **10.51** | 94.7% | 11.10 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs TEN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.61** | 96.8% | 16.13 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs MIN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **12.04** | 96.8% | 12.44 |
| K | *(none rostered — Dominic Zvada on bye)* | — | **0.00** | 0% | 0.00 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | vs LV (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **7.12** | 100% | 7.12 |
| **Total** | | | **132.82** | | |

Bench: Jalen Coker (WR, 10.52 expected updated for live practice — see below), Bo Nix (QB, 15.46, clean hold behind Stafford). On bye this week (NYG/NO), not playable regardless of projection: Dominic Zvada (K), Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB), Isaiah Likely (TE).

## Changes since Monday

**The real fixture flips FLEX2 back to Jameson Williams, and Coker's practice report doesn't change that.** Monday's bridge briefing (sandbox-only, no FantasyPros, no injuries) had Williams over Coker by a razor-thin 0.12 points — inside model noise. Tuesday's real committed fixture, with FantasyPros consensus and ESPN's injury designation on Coker, widens that gap sharply: Williams projects 12.04 expected points against Coker's fixture number of 9.75. Today's live Wednesday overlay raises Coker's P(play) from 85.1% to 91.7% (Full Participation on a Questionable shoulder), which lifts his expected points to 10.52 — still 1.5 points behind Williams. Williams starts; this is not a close call once the real fixture and real injury data are both in, even generously updated in Coker's favor.

Everything else holds from Monday: Stafford/Taylor/Irving/JSN/London/LaPorta/Higgins are the same players in the same slots, now running on the real fixture's higher numbers (consensus + availability) rather than Monday's in-house-only sandbox estimates.

**The kicker hole is unresolved, three Wednesdays running Zvada's bye has been visible.** Dominic Zvada remains the only rostered K and NYG's bye zeroes the slot exactly as flagged Monday. No waiver move has landed per a fresh read of `roster.json`.

## Still uncertain

- **Drake London's head designation.** Questionable, no ATL practice report yet. The model's 90.4% P(play) comes entirely from his clean 2026 history (played all 7 games so far) plus the bare Questionable tag — there is no practice-participation signal in it at all. Re-check Thursday/Friday once Atlanta reports; a DNP would be a materially different number than a Full/Limited.
- **Jalen Coker, inversely.** His practice signal is in (Full Participation) and he's trending toward a normal snap share, but it doesn't matter for this week's lineup call — he trails Williams by 1.5 points even at his best-case number. Worth revisiting only if Williams' own health or role changes.
- **The kicker slot**, which isn't an uncertainty so much as an open action item: claim a replacement before Sunday. Jake Bates (DET, 8.19 expected vs MIN, same game as LaPorta/Williams) is the fixture's own top-ranked K waiver target; Wil Lutz (DEN, 7.91 vs KC) and Jason Sanders (NYJ, 7.84 vs LV — his own teammate's game, this roster's DEF) are the alternatives. Without a fix the real total stays ~125 points below the ~140 this roster would otherwise post.

## Opponent notes

- **Bucky Irving (TB, starting RB2) and Drake London (ATL, starting WR2) face each other** Sunday at 1:00pm ET — both start regardless of the other's game, just a notable crossover on this roster, same pattern as last week's Irving/Coker matchup.
- **Sam LaPorta and Jameson Williams are both Lions**, both starting, both facing Minnesota Sunday at 1:00pm ET — a correlated pair rather than a conflict: a good Detroit game script lifts both at once, a bad one (e.g., an early Lions deficit shifting to a run-heavy script) could cap both together.
- **Jalen Coker's game is Thursday night** (CAR@GB, 8:15pm ET) — the earliest lock of the week, tomorrow. He's benched behind Williams regardless, so no action needed, but there's no Wednesday-to-Thursday window to reconsider him if something changes with Williams.
- Jets D/ST's Week 8 matchup is a normal game (vs LV, 1:00pm ET) — no bye, no notable news.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 8 (this week):** Dominic Zvada (K), Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB), Isaiah Likely (TE) — all NYG/NO, the kicker hole this entire report is built around.
- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (RB, TB) and bench Bo Nix (QB, DEN) — flagging now; Irving is a clear starter so this needs a waiver-level replacement plan, not a bench swap.
